units.source_text: 太宰大弍遣使向源氏公子问候：“

en.t: The Assistant Governor of Dazaifu sent a messenger to inquire after Prince Genji: "

units.source_text: 下官远从外省晋京，原拟首先趋谒瑶阶，仰承指教。

en.t: I have come up to the capital from a distant provincial post, and had meant first of all to wait upon Your Highness and receive your guidance.

units.source_text: 岂知公子栖隐在此，今日道经尊寓，但觉心甚惶恐，不胜悲叹。

en.t: I had no idea that you were living here in seclusion; today, as I passed near your residence, I was overcome with awe and sorrow.

units.source_text: 急欲亲来问安，但京中亲朋，均已来此迎候，人目众多，应酬纷烦，

en.t: I long to come in person at once to ask after your health, but relatives and friends from the capital have all come here to greet me, there are many eyes upon us, and the obligations of courtesy are troublesome,
so I deeply fear that some inconvenience might arise.

units.source_text: 故而暂不前来，异日当再奉谒。”

en.t: For that reason I shall not come for the moment, but on another day I will respectfully call on you."

units.source_text: 使者是大弍的儿子筑前守。

en.t: The messenger was the Assistant Governor's son, the Governor of Chikuzen.

units.source_text: 此人曾蒙源氏公子推荐为藏人，以前见过源氏公子。

en.t: This man had once become a chamberlain through Prince Genji's recommendation, and had met Prince Genji before.

units.source_text: 今见公子流离在此，心甚悲伤，又不胜愤慨。

en.t: Now, seeing the prince exiled and adrift here, he was deeply saddened and could not suppress his indignation.

units.source_text: 但目前人多，不便详谈，就匆匆告辞。

en.t: But with so many people present, it was not convenient to speak at length, so he hurriedly took his leave.
As they parted, Prince Genji said to him, "

units.source_text: 我自离京以来，往日亲友，一人也不能会面。

en.t: Since I left the capital, I have not been able to meet even one of my old friends.
It is a rare kindness that you have gone out of your way to visit me."

units.source_text: 对太宰大弍的答词亦类乎此。

en.t: His reply to the Assistant Governor of Dazaifu was much the same.
